nodes.name: Audit Logging & Compliance.md
nodes.summary: Comprehensive guide covering audit logging and compliance features in Setura Hospital OS, including immutable audit trails, structured logging with correlation IDs, compliance design with RLS, role-based log access, retention policies, and integration with external compliance tools. References audit.ts, logger.ts, tracing.ts, and SQL migrations 10, 36, and 23.

nodes.name: Authentication & Authorization.md
nodes.summary: Explains the authentication and authorization model for Setura Hospital OS, covering JWT-based authentication via Supabase Auth, multi-tenant security with hospital isolation, RBAC for global_admin, hospital_admin, doctor, and receptionist roles, the withAuth middleware wrapper, AuthContext structure, token lifecycle management, and API endpoint security patterns.

nodes.name: Multi-Tenant Isolation.md
nodes.summary: Documents how Setura enforces strict multi-tenant isolation between hospitals using RLS, database constraints, and edge function authorization. Covers hospital_id enforcement, the role hierarchy with global_admin cross-hospital access, tenant-scoped query patterns, and safe context switching in edge functions for cross-hospital administrative operations.

nodes.name: Rate Limiting & Abuse Protection.md
nodes.summary: Documents the sliding window rate limiting algorithm and abuse protection mechanisms in Setura Hospital OS. Covers per-endpoint, per-user, and per-hospital rate limit configurations, abuse detection patterns for rapid booking attempts, monitoring and alerting capabilities, and tuning guidance for balancing security and user experience across environments.

nodes.name: Security & Authentication.md
nodes.summary: Overview document for Setura Hospital OS security model, covering multi-tenant isolation, RBAC, JWT validation via Supabase Auth, rate limiting and abuse protection, audit logging, secure configuration management, and healthcare compliance considerations. Intended for developers, security engineers, and operators.

nodes.name: Security Best Practices.md
nodes.summary: Comprehensive security best practices guide for Setura Hospital OS covering secure coding patterns (input validation, output encoding, error handling), secure configuration management, API design and request sanitization, security testing, and deployment security. Addresses SQL injection, XSS, CSRF prevention, and ensures robust authentication, authorization, idempotency, rate limiting, and auditability.
